title: IoT-Based Electrical Power Monitoring System
description:
Project Overview

Development of an IoT-based electrical power monitoring system to monitor the company's electricity consumption.

Project Objective

To provide better visibility of electrical energy consumption through a monitoring system, supporting energy management and operational monitoring.

Solution

Developed an IoT-based monitoring solution for collecting and monitoring electrical power consumption data.

The system was intended to make electrical energy usage information more accessible for monitoring and analysis.

My Contribution

Involved in the development and implementation of the electrical power monitoring solution as part of the company's Industry 4.0 initiatives.
technologies: Industrial IoT, Electrical Power Monitoring, Data Acquisition, Energy Monitoring, Industry 4.0
